guide.intro: Learn how to make the most of every PronunFit feature 🚀

nav.title: How to Navigate
nav.s1Desc: Tap the ☰ button at the top left to open the full menu. Tap outside the menu or press ✕ to close it.
nav.s2Desc:
Swipe left or right to move between tabs in order.
← Swipe left = Next tab
→ Swipe right = Previous tab
nav.s3Desc: At the bottom of the screen, ● ● ● ● ● ● dots show your current position. Tap a dot to jump to that tab. The active tab is shown as an elongated green capsule (━).

scene.title: Dialogue
scene.subtitle: Pick a real-world scene and practice with AI
scene.s1Desc:
Tap [📍 Locations] or [🌟 Situations] at the top to switch categories, then tap your desired item (e.g., Restaurant, Hospital).
If you don't see the scene you want, tap [✏️ Custom] and type it yourself.
scene.s2Desc:
Difficulty: Tap one of [Basic] [Intermediate] [Advanced]
Style: [Casual] = everyday talk / [Formal] = polite register
The selected button is highlighted in green.
scene.s3Desc:
🟢 [Generate Question] → A sentence you'd ask in that scene
🟣 [Generate Answer] → A sentence you'd reply with
AI instantly creates natural expressions that native speakers actually use.
scene.s4Desc: Tap the [🎙️ Mic button] at the bottom of the card to start recording. Speak the sentence and it will be automatically analyzed, showing Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody scores.
scene.s5Desc:
Tap [☆ Star button] at the top right of the card → When it changes to [⭐ filled star], it's saved!
If your pronunciation score meets the target, it also counts toward today's learning goal.
scene.tip1: 💡 Practice the same scene in Casual → Formal order to master situational nuances
scene.tip2: 💡 Advanced difficulty produces native-level expressions — recommended for intermediate+
scene.tip3: 💡 Try typing specific situations like "job interview" or "first date" in Custom input

translation.title: Dictionary
translation.subtitle: Translate words & sentences + AI learning tips
translation.s1Desc: Tap the center input field and type the word or sentence to translate. Use the language buttons above the input (e.g., [Korean] [English]) to select the source language.
translation.s2Desc: Tap the [🟢 Translate] button to get translations in up to 3 languages simultaneously. You can change target languages in ☰ Menu → ⚙️ Settings.
translation.s3Desc: Tap [💡 View Learning Tips ▼] at the bottom of the translation card to reveal AI-generated grammar explanations, example sentences, similar expressions, and nuance differences.
translation.s4Desc: Tap the [🔊 Speaker button] on the card to hear native TTS pronunciation. Use it to listen and repeat.
translation.s5Desc: Tap [🎙️ Mic button] → Speak the sentence to receive Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody scores with phoneme-level feedback. Use [🎧 Listen to My Voice] to compare with the native speaker.
translation.s6Desc: Tap [☆ Star button] → When it becomes ⭐, it's saved. The pronunciation score is saved together so you can review and re-practice in Library later.
translation.tip1: 💡 Words (W) and sentences (S) are auto-categorized — you can filter them separately in Library
translation.tip2: 💡 Chinese translations include Pinyin; Japanese translations include Hiragana pronunciation guides automatically
translation.tip3: 💡 English speakers can set the source language to English and use it to learn Korean

pronunciation.title: How to Read Pronunciation Scores
pronunciation.subtitle: 3 scores & phoneme anatomy explained
pronunciation.s1Desc: Measures how accurately you pronounced each word. If low → focus on correcting individual word pronunciation.
pronunciation.s2Desc: Measures how smoothly and naturally you read the sentence. If low → practice reading without pausing between words.
pronunciation.s3Desc: Measures how closely your stress, intonation, and rhythm match a native speaker. If low → practice stress placement and intonation patterns consciously.
pronunciation.s4Desc:
Expand the [Phoneme Anatomy] section below the scores to see color-coded results per word.
🟢 Green = Good  🟡 Yellow = Needs work  🔴 Red = Mispronounced
Focusing on 🔴 red words for repeated practice is the most efficient method.
pronunciation.s5Desc: Use the [🎧 Listen to My Voice] button to play back your recording and directly compare it with the native TTS.
pronunciation.tip1: 💡 Start with a 70-point accuracy goal → gradually raise it to 85+ as you improve
pronunciation.tip2: 💡 Prosody scores vary by language (limited support for Korean, Vietnamese, etc.)

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Review & manage saved cards
library.s1Desc: Type part of a word or sentence in the search bar at the top for real-time search across all saved cards.
library.s2Desc:
Language dropdown: View only a specific language (English, Japanese, Chinese, etc.)
[W] = Words only / [S] = Sentences only
[🎯 Missed]: Filter cards below the target score → ideal for focused weak-point review
library.s3Desc: Tap the [🔊 Speaker button] on a card to hear native TTS pronunciation.
library.s4Desc: Tap the [🎙️ Mic button] on a card to re-practice pronunciation anytime. The score updates and is saved.
library.s5Desc: Tap the [📝 Memo button] to add your own learning points, examples, or memory tips.
library.s6Desc: Tap [🗑️ Delete button] → Confirm in the popup to remove the card. You can re-save the same sentence later.
library.tip1: 💡 Open Library daily and use the "Missed" filter to spend 5 minutes on weak cards
library.tip2: 💡 Writing "hard-to-remember points" in memos helps with long-term retention

vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.subtitle: AI-generated topic-based word cards
vocab.s1Desc:
Tap one of 7 categories (Daily Life · Travel · Business · Education · Social · Tech · Culture) to expand subcategories. Tap a subcategory to reveal 5 topics.
Example: Travel → Transport & Getting Around → Taxi & Rental Car
vocab.s2Desc:
Use the [Basic] [Intermediate] [Advanced] buttons above the topics to set difficulty.
Basic = essential everyday words / Intermediate = practical expressions / Advanced = specialized, native-level vocabulary
vocab.s3Desc:
After selecting a topic, the [Generate Words] button activates. Tap it and AI (Gemini) instantly creates 5 words matching your topic.
Tap [More Words] on the same topic to get new words, excluding ones you've already seen.
vocab.s4Desc:
Each card shows the word, pronunciation, meaning, example sentence, and example translation.
Tap the [🔊 Speaker] button to hear the native pronunciation of the word or example sentence.
vocab.s5Desc:
Tap the [☆ Star button] on the right of a card to save it to Library.
Saved words can be reviewed and pronunciation-practiced anytime in Library.
vocab.tip1: 💡 Generate words Basic → Intermediate → Advanced on the same topic for progressive vocabulary building
vocab.tip2: 💡 Tap [More Words] repeatedly for unlimited vocabulary from the same topic
vocab.tip3: 💡 Reading example sentences aloud helps you naturally learn words in context

video.title: Video
video.subtitle: Learn languages with curated YouTube videos
video.s1Desc:
Select your target language at the top, then tap one of 4 categories: [News] [Culture] [Entertainment] [Sports].
Curated YouTube channel videos for that language and category will load automatically.
video.s2Desc:
Tap a video thumbnail from the list to start playback instantly.
Use the [Open on YouTube] button below the video for full-screen viewing.
video.s3Desc:
In the memo field below the video, freely jot down expressions you hear, unknown words, or key sentences.
Building a habit of pausing the video to take notes significantly boosts learning effectiveness.
video.s4Desc:
Tap [Translate Notes] to automatically send your memo to the Dictionary (Translation) tab.
From the translation results, you can continue to pronunciation practice — enabling integrated listening → writing → speaking learning.
video.tip1: 💡 Start with the News category to hear clear, standard pronunciation in any language
video.tip2: 💡 Videos from categories you enjoy (Entertainment, Sports) help maintain learning motivation
video.tip3: 💡 Adding timestamps in your notes (e.g., 1:23 — expression) makes later review much easier

goal.title: Learning Goals & Progress
goal.subtitle: Set daily goals for consistent learning
goal.s1Desc: Go to ☰ Menu → [⚙️ Settings] → drag the [Daily Learning Goal] slider to set your target between 1–20 cards per day.
goal.s2Desc:
Always displayed in the app header.
🎯 3/10  ██████░░░░
Numbers show today's achieved cards / target cards.
goal.s3Desc: When you save a card with a pronunciation score above the target, it counts toward today's total. When you hit your goal, a 🎉 popup appears and you can view the weekly achievement graph.
goal.s4Desc: Go to ☰ Menu → [⚙️ Settings] → [Target Score Goals] slider to set different target scores per language. Default is 80 points.
goal.tip1: 💡 Start with 3–5 cards per day and increase as the habit forms
goal.tip2: 💡 Setting the target score too high makes saving difficult — start at 70 and work up

tutorial.home1Desc: Vocabulary, Dialogue, Listening, Video, and Translator — 5 ways to learn. Tap a menu below to start!
tutorial.home2Desc: Tap the ⭐ star during practice to save cards. Review saved cards anytime from the Library tab.
tutorial.scene1Desc: Tap a category (airport, restaurant, etc.) at the top or use ✏️ Custom to create your own scene. Then tap 🟢 Generate Question / 🟣 Generate Answer to get AI sentences.
tutorial.scene2Desc: Tap the 🎙️ mic button at the bottom of a card to get your pronunciation score. Tap ☆ to save to your library. Saved cards can be reviewed later in ⭐ Library.
tutorial.vocab1Desc: Open one of 7 categories, choose a subcategory → topic. Tap ✨ Generate Words and AI will create 5 words matching the topic.
tutorial.vocab2Desc: Tap 🔊 on a word card to hear native pronunciation, then 🎙️ to get your score. Save to your library with ☆ for later review.
tutorial.translation1Title: Translate + AI learning tips in one go
tutorial.translation1Desc: Type a word or sentence and tap 🟢 Translate. Tap 💡 Learning Tips below the card to see AI-generated grammar explanations, examples, and nuance comparisons.
tutorial.translation2Desc: Tap the 🎙️ mic button on each translation card to get your score. Cards above your target score count toward today's study goal. Save with ☆ to your library.
tutorial.library1Title: Filter to find the cards you want
tutorial.library1Desc: Use the language dropdown and [W] Word / [S] Sentence buttons to sort cards. Type keywords in the search bar to search all saved cards.
tutorial.library2Title: Focus on weak cards for targeted review
tutorial.library2Desc: Tap [🎯 Below Target] to filter cards that haven't reached your target score. Use the 🎙️ button to practice again and update your score.
tutorial.video1Title: Pick a video from your interest category
tutorial.video1Desc: Browse recommended YouTube channels by learning language and category. Watch videos and jot down new expressions in the memo pad.
tutorial.video2Title: Study your notes in the Translation tab
tutorial.video2Desc: Write expressions in the memo pad below the video, then tap 'Translate' to jump to the Translation tab. Check translations and continue with pronunciation practice.
tutorial.settings1Desc: Set your Source Language (native) and Target Language (up to 3 languages to learn). For example, if learning English: Source=Korean, Target=English.
tutorial.settings2Desc: Use the Target Score Goals slider to set goals per language. Set a daily card goal too — you can track progress in real-time on the progress bar.
